title: Work column space rows: no hover buttons; actions live in SpaceHoverCard and right-click menu
answers: Why doesn't the space row in the work column have a + or ⋯ button on hover?
Where do I add a new action for a space in the work column?
Space row faces jump on hover
body:
Space rows in the work column (`SpaceRow` in `components/work/WorkColumn.tsx`) must not render hover-revealed buttons: they push the right-aligned `PresenceAvatars` and unread dot sideways on every row.
Actions reach the user two ways, both built from one list, `preview.actions`:
- `SpaceHoverCard` (from `ChannelItemHoverCard`) shows the list on the shared card handle.
- A `ContextMenu` around the row renders the same list via `ChannelActionItems kind="context"`.
`preview.actions` is `[New session, ...useChannelActions(channel).actions]`. Add new actions there, and keep New session first.
`SpaceActionDialogs` must stay mounted as a sibling of the card, since the actions open dialogs.
The rule is recorded in `features/canvas/AGENTS.md`.
